mutations.name: release judges files by the package's narrower list
kills: worktree release fails closed releases a built tree whose only ignored files are tsbuildinfo

mutations.name: the grace window is skipped
kills: worktree release holds a just-exited agent inside the grace window even when clean

mutations.name: a removal git refused is reported as released
mutations.find: if (removed === null && existsSync(worktree)) return `git would not remove ${worktree}`;
kills: worktree release fails closed reports a refused removal of a clean tree as not released, and keeps the branch

mutations.name: a stale refusal survives a later release
kills: worktree release holds a just-exited agent inside the grace window even when clean

mutations.name: a release stops accepting a merged PR as proof
kills: worktree release after the work landed when gh reports the PR releases a squash-merged branch when gh reports the PR merged at its exact tip
